definitions.explanation: A high-altitude cloud made of small white ripples or grains arranged in regular patterns. Popularly called うろこ{雲|ぐも} (scale clouds) or さば{雲|ぐも} (mackerel clouds), and associated with a 'mackerel sky'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻積雲|けんせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: Cirrocumulus clouds float in the sky.

examples.japanese: {巻積雲|けんせきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりやすい→変わりやすい：21113_kawariyasui⟧。
examples.english: When cirrocumulus clouds appear, the weather tends to change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧{巻積雲|けんせきうん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧うろこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようだった。
examples.english: The cirrocumulus clouds spreading across the autumn sky looked just like fish scales.

notes:
A high cloud of the ⟦{巻雲|けんうん}→巻雲：21944_kenun⟧ (cirrus) family, made of tiny white masses. Forming far higher than ⟦{高積雲|こうせきうん}→高積雲：29514_kousekiun⟧, it is a classic sign of autumn skies and approaching weather change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うろこ{雲|ぐも}: scale clouds — everyday nickname for {巻積雲|けんせきうん}
- さば{雲|ぐも}: mackerel clouds — another common nickname

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高積雲|こうせきうん}→高積雲：29514_kousekiun⟧: altocumulus — similar ripples but lower and coarser
- ⟦{巻雲|けんうん}→巻雲：21944_kenun⟧: cirrus — wispy high clouds of the same family
